headword: {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}
gloss: evening star; Venus (in the evening sky)

definitions.gloss: evening star; Venus (in the evening sky)
definitions.explanation: The planet Venus when visible in the western sky after sunset. A poetic and traditional Japanese name for the bright planet that appears in the early evening.

examples.japanese: {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see the evening star in the western sky.

examples.japanese: {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明星|みょうじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{金星|きんせい}→金星：15896_kinsei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to learn that the evening star and the morning star are the same planet Venus.

notes:
A classical and literary name for Venus when it appears in the evening sky. The word ⟦{宵|よい}→宵：27202_yoi⟧ means 'early evening' and {明星|みょうじょう} means 'bright star.' Venus is the brightest object in the night sky after the moon, making it easily identifiable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: the evening star shines
- {宵|よい}の{明星|みょうじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: the evening star is visible

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明星|みょうじょう}: morning star — Venus when visible before sunrise
- ⟦{金星|きんせい}→金星：15896_kinsei⟧: Venus — the astronomical name
- ⟦{一番星|いちばんぼし}→一番星：08953_ichibanboshi⟧: the first star visible in the evening — often Venus
- ⟦{宵|よい}→宵：27202_yoi⟧: early evening — the period just after sunset
